notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 59,800.00. The 50% advance of QAR 29,900.00 is received in full by this receipt. Balance QAR 29,900.00 — 45% QAR 26,910.00 on delivery of materials at site, and 5% QAR 2,990.00 after successful testing, commissioning and handover.

Received with thanks, subject to realisation of the cheque. Material will be ordered and the programme will commence upon clearance: material delivery 4 to 6 days, site mobilisation within 3 working days of material arrival, installation 12 to 16 working days on a civil-ready site, and testing and commissioning 1 to 2 working days thereafter.

SITE READINESS. Please ensure the room position is clear, level and accessible, and that the main power supply and the cable run from the main distribution board to the cold room control panel are available, together with a drainage point within 3 m of the evaporators, as these are by others under our quotation.

SITE SURVEY. Final room dimensions will be confirmed on site before fabrication. Any change arising will be advised to you in writing, with its effect on the price and the programme, before the work is done.
This receipt is issued against INV-291/2026 and is subject to the terms of our approved quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ130/2026 (Revised).
